modelAnswer:
Dear George,

I’m writing to ask for your help. Our school will hold an English poetry recitation contest next month, and I have signed up. Each of us must recite a poem of two to three minutes from memory, and the judges will score us on pronunciation, feeling and stage manner.

Since I have read few English poems, could you recommend one or two for me? I’d prefer a poem that is not too difficult but has strong feelings, so that I can really understand it and move the audience.

Besides, I’d like some tips on reciting. Where should I pause and which words should I stress? How can I show my feelings without overacting?

Could I come to your office this Friday afternoon? Thanks a lot!

Yours,
Li Hua

taskRequires: 读者是外教 George，身份是要参加学校英文诗朗诵比赛的李华；交际动作是写邮件求助。
三个要点都要落到句子上：说明比赛要求、请他推荐英文诗、请教朗诵技巧；约 80 词。
称呼 Dear George,、首句 I’m writing to ask for your help.、结尾 Yours, 和署名 Li Hua 照题面原样保留，首句接正文第一段。
taskCard.thisEssayChooses: 比赛要求补成“下个月举行、背诵两到三分钟的诗、按发音情感台风打分”，这些细节可以换成别的合理要求；选诗写明“不太难、感情强”的偏好，技巧问停顿、重读和表达感情两类问题；结尾约周五下午去办公室面谈。语气对老师礼貌、直接，用 could you 和 I’d prefer 提请求。

standard.essay:
Dear George,

I’m writing to ask for your help. Our school will hold an English poetry recitation contest next month, and I have signed up. Each of us must recite a poem of two to three minutes from memory, and the judges will score us on pronunciation, feeling and stage manner.

Since I have read few English poems, could you recommend one or two for me? I’d prefer a poem that is not too difficult but has strong feelings, so that I can really understand it and move the audience.

Besides, I’d like some tips on reciting. Where should I pause and which words should I stress? How can I show my feelings without overacting?

pointMap.quote: Each of us must recite a poem of two to three minutes from memory, and the judges will score us on pronunciation, feeling and stage manner.
could you recommend one or two for me?
Besides, I’d like some tips on reciting.

notes.role: 接着给定首句交代为什么求助，并把比赛要求说清楚，为后面的请求定下条件。

items.explain: 一句话说明“我要参赛”，George 马上明白这封信和他有什么关系。

items.quote: recite a poem of two to three minutes from memory
items.explain: 把“要求”写成时长和“背诵”这样看得见的条件，后面推荐诗的长短才有依据；不要只写“有一些要求”。

items.quote: the judges will score us on pronunciation, feeling and stage manner
items.explain: 列出评分的三方面，正好引出第三段要问的技巧，前后呼应。

notes.role: 提出第一个请求：请他推荐诗，并说明想要什么样的诗。

items.quote: Since I have read few English poems
items.explain: 先说自己的处境再提请求，理由站在“我确实需要你帮忙”上，请求不显得突兀。

items.quote: I’d prefer a poem that is not too difficult but has strong feelings
items.explain: 给出选诗标准，George 读完就知道该推荐哪类诗，比只说“推荐一首诗”更好回应。

items.quote: so that I can really understand it and move the audience
items.explain: so that 说明这样选的目的，把选诗和比赛打分里的“感情”连起来。

notes.role: 提出第二个请求：请教朗诵技巧，把问题问具体。

items.quote: Besides, I’d like some tips on reciting.
items.explain: Besides 标出这是另一件事，第三个要点一眼就能找到。

items.quote: Where should I pause and which words should I stress?
items.explain: 把“技巧”拆成停顿和重读两个具体问题，老师可以逐条回答；空泛地问 any advice 很难回。
说出自己担心的毛病，问题更真实，也显出确实想过怎么朗诵。

notes.role: 提出下一步：约时间当面请教，再道谢收住。

items.quote: Could I come to your office this Friday afternoon?
items.explain: 结尾落在一个具体的时间和地点上，George 只要回答“行”或“换个时间”，比“期待回复”更能推动事情。

expressions.function: 说明比赛“脱稿背诵”的要求，recite 正是朗诵比赛里“背诵朗读”的意思。

expressions.expression: could you recommend one or two for me?
expressions.function: 向老师提出推荐请求，one or two 给对方留余地，语气礼貌。
请教朗诵时既要有感情又不能夸张，说出这一类比赛最常见的难点。

advanced.essay:
Dear George,

I’m writing to ask for your help. Our school is holding an English poetry recitation contest in three weeks, and I’ve signed up, both excited and a little nervous. Each contestant has to recite a poem of two to three minutes by heart, and the judges will score us on pronunciation, emotion and stage presence.

As most poems I know are Chinese, choosing an English one is my biggest headache. Could you recommend one or two that a high school student can handle? I’d love one with a clear story or strong feelings, so that I can make it my own rather than memorize the words.

I’d also appreciate some tips on delivery. Where should I pause, and which words deserve stress? How can I show emotion naturally instead of overacting, especially when I get nervous?

If it’s convenient, could I drop by your office this Friday afternoon and recite a few lines for you? Thank you!

Yours,
Li Hua

pointMap.quote: Each contestant has to recite a poem of two to three minutes by heart, and the judges will score us on pronunciation, emotion and stage presence.
Could you recommend one or two that a high school student can handle?
I’d also appreciate some tips on delivery.

beyondStandard.quote: both excited and a little nervous
beyondStandard.explain: 补一句真实的心情，像学生在跟熟悉的外教说话，也让后面的求助更自然。

beyondStandard.quote: so that I can make it my own rather than memorize the words
beyondStandard.explain: make it my own 是地道说法，说明想真正读懂并表达这首诗，比标准版的 understand it 更贴朗诵比赛。

beyondStandard.quote: could I drop by your office this Friday afternoon and recite a few lines for you?
beyondStandard.explain: drop by 比 come to 更口语、更贴近师生关系；提出当面试读几行，下一步更具体，老师也更好指导。
